svg.text: Deep Session Telemetry · API Time vs. Local Shell/Render vs. +600s Zombie Server Wait & Reasoning Share
Inside the Session Logs: The +600s Zombie Server Penalty, Reasoning Bloat & Prompt Caching
Models ordered by recorded wall time (gpt-5-mini 9.7m to grok-4.7 143.7m). Red blocks in Panel A show 10–20m lost to unstopped background http.server tasks.
Local Render / Tool Exec (Playwright, ffmpeg, soffice)
A. 8-Task Wall Time: API + Tool + Zombie Wait (min)
B. Reasoning % of Out Tokens & View() Calls
Note: Removing the single +600s zombie http.server wait moves gpt-5.6-luna from 24.1m (#11) to 14.1m (#2 fastest overall) and cuts mai-code-1.1-flash from 44.2m to 24.2m.
